test_title: PYST 19: Selection Post (Graduation Level) - Reasoning (Held On 8 Feb 2022 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Three different positions of the same dice are shown, the six faces of which are numbered from 1 to 6. Select the number that will be on the face opposite to the one having '1'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/416a44204fb3228f4040e8a893a32d2706c1d19634e985612d06ab3176e6f1e2.png]
solution:
In First and Third dice 2, 3 are common in both dice.

Third dice is rotated 180⁰ clockwise the other adjacent side of 2, 3 is '6'.

Logic : If two dice have the same two face value in the given image then the third number is opposite to each other.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cdf085c64708e8eedf646c73aaaa8c43e1d37b6b837c717a25772639d8cc77c4.png] 

∴ Here, '6' is opposite face of '1'.

Hence, the correct answer is **"6".**
